procedure.step0: Step 0, before any training or scoring: re-decode p1dev_s42 on dev300 on this job's machine (evaluate.py, short prompt, bf16, its defaults) under the name p1dev_s42_redecode. Every paired comparison uses this same-machine decode. Its agreement with the registered n2 decode (share of identical captions, CIDEr-D difference) is reported, never used to select anything. It is the 100% point.
procedure.data: write each subset's ids file from this JSON and assert its sha256; build its SFT rows with build_gold_sft.py --annotations train_data.json --out gold_p1dev_f<pct> --images-file <ids file> and assert the registered sft.jsonl sha256
procedure.train: job 35_a with --data gold_p1dev_f<pct> and R = p1dev_s42_f<pct>: train_stage2.py --stage sft --epochs 2 --seed 42 --loss-mask assistant; the last checkpoint only
procedure.decode: evaluate.py --model qwen2.5-vl-7b --adapter <run> --split dev_data.json --prompt short (NCS_DATASET=ktvic_dev, its defaults)

analysis.points: x = log2(N) for N = 867, 1734, 3469 training images
analysis.metrics: dev300 CIDEr-D x100 (mean of rl_report.dev_scores per-image values), object F1 vs ktvic5 (object_prf.scores, exact classes) and CHAIR_i of each model
analysis.fit: ordinary least squares y = a + b x over the three points, separately for CIDEr-D (b), F1 and CHAIR_i

ci.method: paired percentile bootstrap over dev images (the same resampled images for all three models; corpus metrics recomputed, slope refitted)
ci.covers: dev-image sampling only; one training seed per size, so seed variance is not in the CI

decision_rule.rule: FUND_EXTERNAL_IMAGE_DATA if CI_lo(b) > +1; CLOSE_DATA_VOLUME_LEVERS if b < +1; INCONCLUSIVE otherwise (no external-data spend)

meaning.CLOSE_DATA_VOLUME_LEVERS: every data-volume lever for KTVIC is closed and reported as a finding

disclosures: R14-4's n-gram coverage proxy (coverage.py) read the KTVIC test references (not any model output) and informed the predicted slope.
The 100% point, p1dev_s42, was trained earlier on n2; the 25% and 50% models are trained on M1/M2 with the same recipe, card type and base revision (the base revision of the earlier run is inferred).
The subset permutation is the same seeded order train_rl.schedule gives the RL images of S3; the subsets are uniform random prefixes of it.
deviations: Any change after this freeze goes into a new dated file, committed through the gatekeeper before the affected output exists, and is reported as a deviation next to every number it touches.
